## Pull request checklist

- [ ] I have tested the changes or explained why testing is not applicable.
- [ ] I have reviewed the relevant documentation (README, CONTRIBUTING, and other affected docs).
- [ ] Documentation has been updated where needed, or no update is required (reason: ...).
- [ ] I have reviewed user-facing translations in English and German.
- [ ] Translations have been updated in both languages where needed, or no update is required (reason: ...).
- [ ] I have considered privacy and security implications, where applicable.

## Summary

Describe the change and its motivation.

## Testing

Describe the tests and validations performed.
